subject: calendar.records

recordTypes.summary: One governed standing commitment whose meaning and relations remain distinct from its configured scheduling source.

fields.summary: The governed series, event, or obligation-window classification.
The factual purpose that gives the commitment organizational meaning.
Exact configured participant identities when they are available.
The exact external event identity used only to join the configured time authority.

content.summary: Commitment meaning is represented by normalized fields and does not duplicate scheduling content.

limitations: This model owns portable commitment meaning and relations only; event time and recurrence remain authoritative in the configured scheduling source.
The governed context.calendar vocabulary artifact owns the exact current commitment term and definition.
The model grants no calendar read, reconciliation, event creation, meeting creation, provider write, or synchronization authority.
